Happiness rises with different decorations, pens and services: wells, schools, libraries, fountains and markets.
Complete today’s requests for coins and XP. Resets in %1$s (UTC midnight).

Build your village one tile at a time. Drag to explore and pinch to zoom. Build opens the catalogue: move the preview, rotate and confirm. Paint paths, fences and flowers by dragging. With a tool selected, use two fingers to move the camera.

My goal guides you to the next action. Plant, harvest, collect taxes, feed animals and deliver orders. Tap a golden reward to collect it in one gesture. Collect all unlocks after chapter 10. Decorations add charm and services improve happiness.

Waiting? Journal → Work offers free activities: twelve correct actions earn five minutes of work to spend on construction, crops or orders. Farming earns work too. Adventure opens battles, heroes, teams and research; everything is earned through play, with no purchases. Battles remain available freely; invitation rewards follow their own pace.

Village → Neighbors lets you explore twelve villages, place free orders and help prepare parcels. My realms lets you travel, rename villages and found new lands. Creative mode provides free construction in a separate world.

Tools let you copy, rearrange, fill and undo. A construction already used or involved in a claimed reward cannot be undone; move or sell it instead. Village also contains the chronicle, photo mode and import/export.

Your world saves automatically. Exit, at the top right, saves and returns to the app. Your village keeps growing while you are away.
